verifications.claim: Due to the new two-board system, the first-phase CBSE Class 10 results for 2026 are being released earlier than usual to accommodate the second board exams.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Why CBSE 10th result 2026 will be announced early? CBSE 10th result 2026 will be announced early since the second board exams are scheduled to be held from May 15." (R1); "CBSE Class 10 Result 2026 Live Updates: Early Result due to Second Board Exam CBSE 10th result 2026 will be released early this year since the second board exam is scheduled to be conducted from May 15." (R1); "To ensure the smooth conduct of that phase, the board is aiming to release the first-phase results earlier." (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references explicitly state that results are released early due to the new two-board system and second exams starting May 15, directly matching the claim.

verifications.claim: The CBSE 10th Result 2026 websites are results.cbse.nic.in, cbse.gov.in, or cbseresults.nic.in.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Visit CBSE website-cbse.gov.in, results.cbse.nic.in" (R1); "Students can check their results on the following CBSE website: cbse.gov.in results.cbse.nic.in" (R1); "results.cbse.nic.in cbse.gov.in" (R1); "cbse.gov.in and cbseresults.nic.in" (R3)
verifications.reasoning: References directly list these exact websites for checking CBSE Class 10 2026 results.

verifications.claim: DigiLocker or UMANG App are alternative methods for CBSE 10th Result 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "They can also check their results at DigiLocker, UMANG, SMS." (R1); "DigiLocker UMANG" (R1); "CBSE 10th result 2026 can also be checked via SMS, IVRS, Digilocker, Parinam Manjusha, and the Umang App." (R3); "students can access their marksheets through Digilocker & UMANG." (R4)
verifications.reasoning: All listed references confirm DigiLocker and UMANG as alternative methods to access results.

verifications.claim: CBSE Class 10 Phase 1 exam dates are February 17 – March 11, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "CBSE 10th exams were held from February 17 to March 11." (R1); "CBSE Class 10 exam date 2026 17-Feb-2026 to 11-Mar-2026" (R1); "CBSE Class 10 2026 exam was conducted from February 17 to March 11, 2026." (R3); "CBSE 10th 2026 exam was conducted from February 17 to March 11." (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Exact dates for Phase 1 (main) exams match across multiple references.

verifications.claim: Roll number, school number, admit card ID, and date of birth are needed for CBSE 10th Result 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Students need to enter details such as their roll number, school number, admit card ID, date of birth, and the security code." (R1); "To download the CBSE 10th result scorecard, the student need to enter their login details such as their Roll Number, Enter School No, Date of Birth and Admit Card ID." (R3)
verifications.reasoning: R1 lists exactly these details required for login; R3 confirms the same set.
